[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][/size][/font][/center][center][size=2][font=Comic Sans MS]୨୧------------------------------------------------------------------------୨୧
Hi!!! We meet again!!! (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞ
This is version 5 of my hair collection. And of course, this adds 5 new dyeable hairstyles just like usual!
Remember to have Fashion Sense in your Mods folder!
A quick tip, if you want a pastel color of my hairstyles, you just need to find the png file of the hairstyle you want and edit the color.
I often use PaintTool Sai to edit colors. You can use other tools to edit the colors you want too. ╰(*°▽°*)╯
Hope you enjoy this mod! Feel free to leave comments if there is anything I need to improve!!! (❁´◡`❁)
